description: This file defines the interface and data structures for managing Git worktrees, including functions to retrieve, validate, repair, and manipulate worktree information, as well as to handle linked worktrees and their configurations.

methods.name: get_worktrees
methods.description: Retrieve all worktrees; the primary worktree is first, followed by linked worktrees.

methods.name: get_worktrees_without_reading_head
methods.description: Retrieve worktrees without reading HEAD to avoid parsing failures, useful when the refdb may be inconsistent.

methods.name: submodule_uses_worktrees
methods.description: Check if submodules use worktrees based on the given path.

methods.name: get_worktree_git_dir
methods.description: Get the Git directory path of a specified worktree.

methods.name: find_worktree
methods.description: Find a worktree unambiguously by pathname or shorthand.

methods.name: get_linked_worktree
methods.description: Retrieve a linked worktree by its ID.

methods.name: find_worktree_by_path
methods.description: Find a worktree matching the given path.

methods.name: is_main_worktree
methods.description: Determine if a given worktree is the main one.

methods.name: worktree_lock_reason
methods.description: Get the reason why a worktree is locked.

methods.name: worktree_prune_reason
methods.description: Get the reason why a worktree should be pruned, considering expiration.

methods.name: should_prune_worktree
methods.description: Decide if a worktree should be pruned and provide the reason.

methods.name: validate_worktree
methods.description: Validate the integrity of a worktree, returning an error message if invalid.

methods.name: update_worktree_location
methods.description: Update the location of worktrees after changes like moves.

methods.name: repair_worktrees
methods.description: Visit linked worktrees to repair corruptions, with callback for each repair or error.

methods.name: repair_worktrees_after_gitdir_move
methods.description: Repair linked worktrees after the main Git directory has been moved.

methods.name: repair_worktree_after_gitdir_move
methods.description: Repair a specific worktree after its Git directory has been moved.

methods.name: repair_worktree_at_path
methods.description: Repair administrative files for a worktree at a specific path.

methods.name: free_worktree
methods.description: Free memory associated with a worktree.

methods.name: free_worktrees
methods.description: Free memory for multiple worktrees.

methods.name: find_shared_symref
methods.description: Check if a symref points to a ref in the main or linked worktrees.

methods.name: is_shared_symref
methods.description: Determine if a symref points to a ref in any worktree.

methods.name: other_head_refs
methods.description: Apply a callback to head refs of worktrees other than the current one.

methods.name: is_worktree_being_rebased
methods.description: Check if a worktree is currently rebasing.

methods.name: is_worktree_being_bisected
methods.description: Check if a worktree is currently bisecting.

methods.name: strbuf_worktree_ref
methods.description: Construct a refname for a worktree.

methods.name: init_worktree_config
methods.description: Initialize worktree configuration for the repository.

methods.name: write_worktree_linking_files
methods.description: Write linkage files for a worktree to connect it with the repository.

ctags.name: head_ref
ctags.pattern: /^	char *head_ref;		\/* NULL if HEAD is broken or detached *\/$/

ctags.name: worktree_repair_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(int iserr,const char * path,const char * msg,void * cb_data)
